question: Does the validated synthetic-rebalanced freshness guard (Jaccard 0.85 required-filtered {id,name,email}+response-derived endpoint _template/X-Csrf-Token+ETag+max-age=0, recalibrated 0.95 fresh/0.85 stale with TN>=0.85 Wilson lower>0.75 FA<=0.10 ECE<=0.15 at 15% stale 360-req=180 fresh+30 stale+150 noise, NC-NOISE-IMMUNITY FA<=0.10) enable bounded C-DELTA-REPAIR on the same locally-hosted single-resource flat-JSON substrate (/resource/{id} stdlib http.server, deterministic _matches verification, honest per-trajectory-reset constant sum-counter resolve+bind+verify+freshness+browser_steps without jitter/n*3200/f*6.0/parity, trajectory-grouped max|rho_shuffled|<0.20, 5000 family-stratified trajectory-grouped bootstrap) such that a controlled single-resource perturbation (DOM attribute/text via Jaccard, endpoint param/header via _template/X-Csrf-Token, Cache-Control/ETag one resource only) requires localized repair with delta cost <50% tokens-equivalent and browser interactions <40% vs cold re-exploration, verification AUROC>=0.75 precision>=0.80, contamination<0.10 behind health-gated verification, and honest M_total_f10 Pareto not inflated, vs B-NO-GUARD and single-signal baselines, before authorizing health-gated distributed shared-WAL transfer (n>=800 non-304, X-Worker-Pid>=2)?
hypothesis: H1-positive: When the synthetic-rebalanced freshness guard (Jaccard 0.85 required-filtered + response-derived _template/X-Csrf-Token + ETag+max-age=0, 0.95/0.85 recalibrated, prevalence-aware UNKNOWN/ECE at 15% stale) is applied on the identical stdlib http.server flat-JSON single-resource /resource/{id} substrate with honest constant integer per-trajectory-reset sum-counter (resolve+bind+verify+freshness base 4 per request, browser_steps 0 fresh / 1 repair probe, no jitter/n*3200/f*6.0/parity/bijective proxy, trajectory-grouped max|rho_shuffled|<0.20, 5000 family-stratified trajectory-grouped bootstrap), a controlled single-resource perturbation (one of dom_drift, param_header_mutation, cache_expiry families, 10 instances per family) is repairable by a localized deterministic patch (re-observe 1-3 per-trajectory cache update + rebind + re-verify, no LLM heuristic) with: (a) repair success >=80% pooled and >=70% per family, (b) mean repair cost <50% of cold full re-exploration tokens-equivalent and mean browser steps <40% of cold, verification steps <=2, (c) verification AUROC>=0.75 precision>=0.80 at frozen threshold separating correct vs incorrect patch (incorrect = random-patch null), (d) contamination <0.10 on N>=20 unrelated mechanisms, (e) honest M_total at f=10/100 (M_total = retrieval+distill+resolve+bind+verify+freshness+browser honest sum-counter aggregated per trajectory) not inflated vs cold (amortized repair+10*retrieval < cold) and trajectory-grouped max|rho_shuffled|<0.20 preserved, (f) freshness TN>=0.85 FA<=0.10 still holds on staleness pool, discriminating vs B-NO-GUARD delta>=0.15 and vs single-signal ablations. Signal necessity remains orthogonal (combined guard required), not pooled-metric salience or cost tautology. Distributed transfer remains future gate, not required for SURVIVES.
falsifier: C-DELTA-REPAIR bounded synthetic is FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if ANY primary locality condition fails while honesty/measurement gates pass: (F1) repair success <0.80 pooled OR <0.70 per family; (F2) mean repair tokens-equivalent >=0.50*mean B-COLD tokens-equiv OR mean browser interactions >=0.40*B-COLD OR verification steps >2; (F3) contamination >=0.10 (fraction unrelated mechanisms invalidated or false-accept after patch, N>=20); (F4) verification AUROC<0.75 OR precision<0.80 at frozen threshold (TRAIN-calibrated 0.85 stale) distinguishing correct patch vs random-patch null; (F5) amortized cost at n_reuses=10 (repair+verify+10*retrieval) >= B-COLD cold cost (no Pareto advantage); (F6) freshness guard degrades to TN<0.85 OR FA>0.10 on same 180+30 staleness pool at 15% prevalence (guard not enabling); (F7) B-NO-GUARD vs SPIDER FA delta <0.15 (no discriminating advantage). MEASUREMENT_INVALID (not falsification) if any honesty gate fails: (M1) sum-counter not honest constant integer (jitter, n*3200/f*6.0, parity, global template, non-integer); (M2) trajectory-grouped max|rho_shuffled|>=0.20 (1000 whole-trajectory-block perms); (M3) within-family freshness std==0 for any drift family (discrimination degenerate); (M4) verification not deterministic src/spider/kernel.py _matches exact equality on required_slots filtered without _template; (M5) per-trajectory observed caching not used or endpoint not response-derived; (M6) 5000 family-stratified trajectory-grouped bootstrap not performed; (M7) N<30 stale or N<12 repairs per family or unrelated set <20; (M8) distributed n_non304 miscounted. Falsification bounded to this signal/threshold/site/confidence/sum-counter/substrate, not broader C-DELTA-REPAIR domain (multi-resource, cross-page, Redis, production CDN, real LLM).

baselines.description: Full cold re-exploration: same intent fetch_resource on same /resource/{id} synthetic site but with empty registry and no prior cache; agent re-explores from scratch: discovery fetches 3 observations to build mechanism, then resolve+bind+verify+freshness. Cost measured with identical honest per-trajectory-reset constant sum-counter (3*4=12 discovery + 4 execution =16 per trajectory baseline) plus browser fetches. No prior knowledge reused. This is the cost delta-repair must amortize against (100% baseline).
baselines.expected: Succeeds on >=90% fresh tasks at full cost ~16 units per trajectory (Wilson CI width). Repair must be <50% tokens-equiv (<=8) and <40% browser (<=0.4*cold probes).

baselines.description: No freshness guard: same 30 stale instances (10 per family) but resolve() always EXECUTABLE when preconditions+required_slots pass, never UNKNOWN. Mechanism from pre-perturbation executed verbatim on post-perturbation resource, with deterministic _matches verification post-hoc only. Matched 180+30+150=360-request workload, same honest counter, same server state. Demonstrates that replay without guard is unsafe and repair without detection is contamination-prone.
baselines.expected: Near 0% correct post-perturbation (verify fails) but false_accept ~1.0 (30/30 stale accepted, contamination high). FA delta vs SPIDER >=0.90 (SPIDER FA<=0.10). Demonstrates guard necessity.

baselines.description: Verbatim route/mechanism replay without repair attempt (0-token replay baseline, Frontier TERX class): stored mechanism executed unchanged, no re-observe patch. Strong 0-cost baseline that must fail post-perturbation to prove perturbation was breaking.
baselines.expected: 0% success post-perturbation (verify fails), 0 repair cost. If success >10%, perturbation non-breaking => MEASUREMENT_INVALID for that family.

baselines.description: Semantic retrieval over prior trajectory memory (embedding search equivalent: Jaccard 0.30 TFIDF over required-filtered field sets + nearest successful trajectory replay). Represents strong retrieval baseline graph must beat; cost includes retrieval lookup (1 unit) + attempted replay. No localized patch applied.
baselines.expected: Retrieves correct family but fails without patch: 20-40% success post-perturbation (partial). Repair should exceed retrieval by >=30pp success and maintain lower contamination.

baselines.description: Ablation: freshness uses only DOM field-set Jaccard <0.85 (required-filtered {id,name,email}), ignoring response-derived Cache-Control/ETag and endpoint _template/X-Csrf-Token mutation. Frozen 0.85 threshold. Tests signal isolation necessity at 15% prevalence with 10 stale per family on same synthetic substrate and honest counter.
baselines.expected: FA ~0.66, TP 10/30 only dom_drift 10/10, param_header 0/10 cache 0/10, fails per-family TP>=0.70 for 2 families, demonstrating combined signal required.

baselines.description: Ablation: freshness uses only Cache-Control+ETag (ETag_changed AND max-age=0) plus response-derived header/endpoint _template mutation, ignoring DOM Jaccard drift. Same frozen thresholds, complementary to B-JACCARD-ONLY.
baselines.expected: FA ~0.33, TP 20/30 (param_header 10/10 + cache 10/10, dom_drift 0/10), fails dom_drift family.

baselines.description: Oracle hand-authored minimal patch (single selector/field-set correction, param rebinding detail->uid, header rotation abc123->xyz789, cache key refresh) applied by experimenter with ground truth, executed and verified deterministically. Upper-bound ceiling for achievable localized repair (1 browser probe +1 verify).
baselines.expected: 100% success with 1 browser probe +1 verify (cost 1+4=5 units). Measured deterministic repair should approach oracle within 2x cost and equal success.

positive_control: PC-LOCALIZED-REPAIR-SUCCEEDS: Two positive controls on same stdlib http.server single-resource substrate with honest counter and deterministic _matches: (PC1) Unperturbed execution: mechanism resolved and verified on pre-perturbation endpoint with no patch, succeeds verify()=true, byte-equivalent body, repair cost 0, contamination 0. (PC2) Known-break single-attribute perturbation with oracle patch: server mutates one resource (dom_drift id int->str + phone add, OR param_header detail->uid + X-Csrf-Token rotation, OR cache ETag+max-age 60->0) and oracle patch updates observed cache (re-observe 1-3) and rebinds; repair succeeds within 1 browser probe +1 verify and verification passes, cost ratio <0.50 vs B-COLD. Both PC1 100% and PC2 >=90% per family required; if either fails, instrumentation broken => MEASUREMENT_INVALID not falsification.
null_control: NC-ZERO-AND-RANDOM-PATCH: Two null controls with honest counter and deterministic _matches: (NC1) Zero perturbation (identical pre/post resource): repair pipeline must produce zero patch (repair cost 0, contamination 0, NC false_accept 0%, verification no trigger) across 180 fresh pool; byte identity pre/post 1.0. (NC2) Random-patch null: on 30 stale instances, propose random incorrect patch (shuffle repair decisions: random field-set/param/header value from unrelated family) and measure verification discrimination — must show AUROC ~0.50 (0.40-0.60) for random, false_accept <=5%, contamination 0 on distant unrelated perturbation (modify endpoint B while target is A, repair of A must be no-op). Also NC-NOISE-IMMUNITY: 150 fresh churn/null noise (phone/nickname/email null) must not trigger repair (FA<=0.10). Both NCs use per-trajectory caching, response-derived signals, trajectory-grouped permutation.
measurement_validity: V1_DETERMINISTIC_VERIFICATION: postcondition verification via src/spider/kernel.py _matches(required, actual) exact equality on required_slots = set(parameter_slots) | _template_slots(action_template) filtered without _template; no heuristic/LLM judge; hashes logged per request; verification AUROC computed from _matches outcome vs correctness oracle (ground truth selector/param).

V2_HONEST_SUM_COUNTER_CONSTANT_PER_TRAJECTORY_RESET: per-trajectory-reset honest integer sum-counter = resolve+bind+verify+freshness+browser_steps (browser_steps 0 fresh, 1 per repair probe deterministic), integer ops per request base 4 fresh / 5 repair, no traj_idx%2 parity, no f*6.0/n*3200/n*4096, no Gaussian jitter, no bijective proxy; per-request and per-trajectory sums logged, all_int true, vector std disclosure; cost exempt from V5 freshness std gate.

V3_NO_JITTER_NO_PROXY: verification that cost vector contains no injected variance: all costs integers, equal within fresh vs repair strata, integer property holds, std==0 valid for constant strata; trajectory-grouped max rho tests for hidden tautology.

V4_RHO_SHUFFLED_MAX_TRAJECTORY_GROUPED: max |Pearson rho| between shuffled cost labels and outcome over 1000 permutations shuffling WHOLE TRAJECTORY BLOCKS preserving within-trajectory dependence, max (primary) <0.20 and mean auxiliary reported; covers prior n*3200/f*6.0/parity tautology and mean-vs-max misreporting; also computed for M_total vs freshness outcome.

V5_WITHIN_FAMILY_STD_OUTCOME: within-each-drift-family std of freshness binary stale flag and repair success must be >0 for discrimination; binary flag std 0.458 expected (5 fresh+5 stale per trajectory); cost std gate EXCLUDED (V2); stable-only exempt no stale variation; per-family verification score std>0 for AUROC validity.

V6_TRAJECTORY_GROUPED_BOOTSTRAP_5000: 5000 family-stratified trajectory-grouped bootstrap resampling at trajectory/family level (12 fresh trajs 15 each=180, 6 stale trajs 3 families 2 each x10 with 5 fresh+5 stale=30 stale+15 fresh pre-drift counted already +15 noise trajs 10 each=150), stratified preserving 180 fresh +10 per family stale +150 noise + repair instances 30 (10 per family), recompute repair success, token ratio, browser ratio, contamination, AUROC, precision, FA delta, TN per iteration for 95% percentile CIs; preserves dependence, avoids hiding per-family 0/10 via pooled.

V7_WILSON_CI: Wilson score interval z=1.96 for repair success, TN, FA, contamination, precision on raw counts not smoothed; lower bound for TN/success, upper for FA/contamination; non-degeneracy check: width>0 required for informative precision; degenerate [1.0,1.0] flagged as ceiling effect per prereg.

V8_ECE_CALIBRATION_RECALIBRATED_PREVALENCE_AWARE: ECE over 10 equal-width bins [0,0.1)...[0.9,1.0] on SPIDER recalibrated confidence 0.95 fresh/EXECUTABLE and 0.85 stale/UNKNOWN; global ECE <=0.15 and per-class ECE_fresh <=0.15 ECE_stale <=0.15 and UNKNOWN in [0.00,0.18] and [stale_rate-0.05,stale_rate+0.07] (stale_rate 30/210=0.1428); satisfiable proof 180*0.05/210=0.0429+30*0.15/210=0.0214=0.0643 <0.15.

V9_SINGLE_RESOURCE_ISOLATION_SYNTHETIC: synthetic site ONE resource type /resource/{id} only, orthogonal drift families separate trajectories no cross-scheduling, header/body signals separated; repair localized to one resource; contamination measured on N>=20 unrelated mechanisms from disjoint resource ids not perturbed; rebalanced sampling keeps family proportions 10 stale per family.

V10_DETERMINISTIC_FRESHNESS_SIGNAL_RESPONSE_DERIVED: DOM tokens sorted {(field_path,type)} via extract_field_types on JSON body; ETag SHA256(canonical_json_without_template)[:16]; Cache-Control max-age; endpoint_template from response-signaled _template field + X-Csrf-Token header name/value from response (not client dict); all deterministic response-derived; stale = (jaccard_dom<0.85) OR param_template_changed OR (etag_changed AND max-age=0) frozen 0.85.

V11_FAMILY_STRATIFIED_SAMPLING_REBALANCED: 180 fresh (12 trajs x15 no drift) +30 stale (3 families x2 trajs x10 with DRIFT_POINT=6 =>5 fresh+5 stale per traj:10 stale per family) +150 noise (15 trajs x10, 5 per variant) =360 total workload; repair tested on 30 stale instances (10 per family); unrelated set 20 mechanisms from separate ids; staleness pool 210 (180+30) for TN/FA.

V12_LOCAL_SYNTHETIC_VS_DISTRIBUTED_DEFERRED: synthetic stdlib http.server on 127.0.0.1 ephemeral port no external deps for primary gate; distributed Flask/JWT+nginx shared-WAL n>=800 stage explicitly DEFERRED per Director PARK and handoff why_next — not required for SURVIVES, logged as NOT_ATTEMPTED with dependency runtime health-gated substrate (WAL/journal_mode, 2x gunicorn 23, nginx 1.24, HS256, X-Worker-Pid>=2, If-None-Match 304).

V13_GROUND_TRUTH_LOGGING: every request logs ground_truth (fresh/stale/noise), family, trajectory_id, request_number, url, response body, ETag, Cache-Control, threshold decision, confidence 0.95/0.85, _matches outcome, repair cost, contamination flag to raw_evidence/*.json with SHA256, per-trajectory cache contents to per_trajectory_cache.json, repair logs to repair_logs.json.

V14_PER_TRAJECTORY_OBSERVED_CACHING_RESPONSE_DERIVED_ENDPOINT: cache postconditions = dom_tokens/header_tokens/endpoint_template observed from pre-drift requests 1-5 per trajectory (first valid deterministic) not global precomputed; repair patch = delta between live response-derived signal and cached response-derived signal; closes prior client-internal gaps; If-None-Match 304 not exercised on synthetic (deterministic ETag) but logic preserved.

V15_VERIFICATION_THRESHOLD_TRAIN_ONLY: verification AUROC/precision threshold (stale confidence 0.85) calibrated on TRAIN split (18 instances: 6 per family) and evaluated on TEST split (12 instances: 4 per family) or leave-one-family-out; no post-state leakage into threshold fitting; permutation null (random patch) AUROC computed trajectory-grouped.

V16_ORTHOGONAL_LEVELS_AUDIT: audit checks combined signal necessity (B-JACCARD-ONLY and B-HEADER-ONLY must fail per-family) and trajectory-grouped max rho + honest counter independently logged; documents that workflow IR/endpoint catalog not tested here.
decision_rule: PRIMARY SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST (bounded synthetic C-DELTA-REPAIR) iff ALL of: (D1) PC1 success=1.0 and PC2 repair success >=0.90 per family, else MEASUREMENT_INVALID; (D2) NC1 cost=0 contamination=0 and NC2 random-patch AUROC in [0.40,0.60] false_accept<=0.05 and NC-NOISE-IMMUNITY FA<=0.10, else MEASUREMENT_INVALID; (D3) freshness TN_SPIDER>=0.85 Wilson lower>0.75 on 180 fresh and false_accept<=0.10 on 30 stale and UNKNOWN in [0.00,0.18]∩[0.0928,0.2128] and global/per-class ECE<=0.15 (satisfiable 0.0643), else FALSIFIED (guard not enabling); (D4) repair success >=0.80 pooled (24/30) Wilson lower>0.65 AND >=0.70 per family (7/10) with 95% family-stratified bootstrap lower>0.60; (D5) mean repair tokens-equiv <0.50*mean B-COLD AND mean browser interactions <0.40*B-COLD AND mean verify steps <=2, with bootstrap 95% upper <0.55 tokens/<0.45 browser; (D6) contamination <0.10 pooled (<=2/20) and per-family contamination <0.15 with Wilson upper<0.20; (D7) verification AUROC>=0.75 and precision>=0.80 at frozen 0.85 threshold on TEST, with random-patch delta AUROC>=0.25; (D8) amortized cost at n_reuses=10 (repair+verify+10*retrieval) < B-COLD cold cost (both tokens-equiv and browser) with honest sum-counter; (D9) B-NO-GUARD FA - SPIDER FA >=0.15 AND B-NO-GUARD FA>0.10 and B-JACCARD-ONLY/B-HEADER-ONLY each fail >=1 family (proving orthogonal necessity); (D10) honesty gates V2-V6 pass: constant integer counter, max|rho_shuffled|<0.20 trajectory-grouped, within-family freshness std>0, 5000 bootstrap done, per-trajectory caching+response-derived verified, verification deterministic _matches, all Wilson/bootstrap CIs width>0 or disclosed degenerate ceiling with Wilson informative (FA upper 0.1135). FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING if any D3-D9 fails while D1-D2 and D10 pass (valid scientific negative). MEASUREMENT_INVALID if any D1-D2 or D10 fails or N<30 stale or per-family n<10 or unrelated N<20. MIXED if family-heterogeneous: >=1 family passes D4-D8 while another fails — report per-family ceilings. DISTRIBUTED stage NOT required: logged as NOT_ATTEMPTED_MEASUREMENT_DEFERRED, does not override synthetic PRIMARY. INCONCLUSIVE only if primary CIs straddle thresholds with width>0.20 due to underpower at n=30 — disclosed but not expected (0/30 upper 0.1135).
product_consequence_positive: PRIMARY SURVIVES: deterministic localized repair on synthetic single-resource substrate achieves >80% success, <50% tokens-equiv and <40% browser vs cold, verification AUROC>=0.75 precision>=0.80, contamination<0.10, amortized Pareto advantage at f=10, while sustaining freshness TN>=0.85 FA<=0.10 calibrated and discriminating vs no-guard/single-signal. This upgrades C-DELTA-REPAIR from HYPOTHESIS/BLOCKED (3 prior BLOCKED) to bounded synthetic EXPERIMENTAL (deterministic stdlib http.server flat-JSON local patch, honest constant sum-counter, trajectory-grouped max rho<0.20, 5000 bootstrap) and validates product utility of freshness as repair enabler: stale detection triggers UNKNOWN, re-observe patch restores EXECUTABLE without full re-exploration, health-gated verification blocks unverified writes containing contamination. Enables: (a) synthetic honest M_total_f10 Pareto (residual-novelty economics) now measurable without tautology; (b) authorizes runtime to harden health-gated distributed shared-WAL Flask/JWT+nginx substrate to n>=800 non-304 for VALIDATED gate; (c) Graph lane may proceed to multi-resource and cross-page repair. Does NOT promote C-FRESHNESS/C-DELTA-REPAIR to VALIDATED/PRODUCT_CORE — requires n>=800 distributed with audit PASS and real LLM/Playwright verification not in this packet; WebArena-Verified v2 param-inherit pilots remain PARKED per Director disposition.
product_consequence_negative: PRIMARY FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING: even behind validated synthetic freshness guard with honest constant sum-counter and deterministic re-observe patch, localized repair fails any of success<0.80, token ratio>=0.50, browser>=0.40, contamination>=0.10, AUROC<0.75/precision<0.80, or amortized not cheaper than cold while honesty gates pass. Demonstrates freshness does not imply delta-repair: detection is necessary but not sufficient — local patch either not localized (requires >50% re-exploration), contaminates unrelated mechanisms (>=0.10), or verification cannot discriminate correct vs random patch (AUROC<0.75). Product must NOT ship delta-repair layer on this substrate; must default to full re-exploration or RAG+re-exploration and budget repair as cold cost; contamination risk requires health-gated verification blocking all unverified writes. Blocks C-DELTA-REPAIR VALIDATED and keeps C-DELTA-REPAIR at HYPOTHESIS/BLOCKED for synthetic, proving orthogonal workflow-IR/endpoint-catalog/WebMCP levels needed before re-attempt, not threshold tweak. Honest M_total_f10 Pareto remains inflated (per Director comparative reasoning: if contamination>=0.10, freshness does not imply delta-repair and product must account full replay). Bounded to this single-resource synthetic deterministic patch; does NOT close multi-resource/distributed/real-LLM repair, but closes cheapest possible locality hypothesis.
estimated_cost: Primary synthetic-rebalanced delta-repair: same stdlib http.server single-resource as parent (reuse research/graph/freshness_detection/execute_rebalanced_35947468747.py scaffold + new execute_delta_repair_synthetic_35949562506.py ~400 lines), N=360 workload (180 fresh+30 stale+150 noise) plus 30 repair instances + B-COLD 12 trajectories + retrieval baseline, 5000 family-stratified trajectory-grouped bootstraps CPU-only <15 min, honest integer sum-counter no LLM tokens, no Docker/browser, <0.8 compute-hour, <$1. No distributed cost (deferred). Total bounded <1 compute-hour even with 1000 trajectory-grouped perms.
expected_information_gain: Very high per Director REOPEN rationale: this is the single highest-leverage blocked prerequisite (C-DELTA-REPAIR 3 prior BLOCKED, starved 1/15 recent, blocks C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY M_total_f10 Pareto and C-PRODUCT-ECON). Tests whether synthetic-rebalanced freshness SURVIVES (TN 1.0 FA 0.0 Wilson informative at n=30) translates into amortized benefit via localized patch: either SURVIVES validates that freshness guard enables contamination-bound repair with honest economics (max|rho|<0.20, no jitter/n*3200/f*6.0) and unblocks VALIDATED distributed transfer, or FALSIFIES proves freshness does not imply delta-repair (contamination>=0.10) and forces product to account full replay — directly changing claim/product decision per Director mandate comparative reasoning vs alternative distributed VALIDATED (degenerate [1.0,1.0] CI) and vs 8 consecutive MEASUREMENT_INVALID param-inherit pilots (marginal info ~0). Minimal single-resource deterministic test isolates localization without LLM BLOCK risk; advances beyond 51-streak distributed MEASUREMENT_INVALID ceiling and beyond stale prevalence saturation.
